# Global Score Agent

> Reputation and trust infrastructure for the ERC-8004 agent ecosystem.

## Products

- HUMI Index: 0–100 reputation score for autonomous agents (ERC-8004).
- WAMI Index: 0–100 reputation score for owner wallets linked to agents.
- Walcert Agent: autonomous ERC-8004 agent issuing A–F wallet maturity certificates (origins, activity, multichain, portfolio) via HTTP JSON + x402. Live identities: Celo 9699 (issuance + Aigora), Base 59768, Ethereum 50032, BNB 265982, Concordium CIS-8004 #1686. Payments: $0.05 USDC on Celo, Base, and BNB (Permit2 + soulbound NFT receipt). Multichain provider: GoldRush v2.1. Presence: Virtuals ACP, Agent.family, Agent City, CDP Bazaar, Aigora.

## Walcert — agent discovery (quick facts)

- API base / agent card: https://walcert.globalscoreagent.com/ (GET / = bilingual agent card JSON)
- Free preview: POST /v1/preview/{origins|activity} (rate limit 8 req/IP / 15 min)
- Paid certificate: POST /v1/certificates/{origins|activity|multichain|portfolio} — x402 $0.05 USDC on Celo, Base, or BNB
- Verify: POST /v1/verify with giveFeedback tx_hash (Celo anchor remains canonical)
- Multichain scoring: GoldRush (Covalent) formula multichain-v2.1 — not Moralis
- BNB receipt NFT (claim by payer): https://bscscan.com/address/0x4e430fB5A5f26ED08eC123373Cd8AD3cE15C24c7
- Aigora profile (same Celo 9699): https://aigora.org/services/42220_0x8004a169fb4a3325136eb29fa0ceb6d2e539a432_9699
- Public repo: https://github.com/MichBarbarian/walcert-agent
- Full facts: https://globalscoreagent.com/llms-full.txt
